plan.title: Adipose treated vs control DE adjusted for sex and age
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is 12 adipose bulk RNA-seq samples (6 treated, 6 control) quantified with Salmon, with sex and age recorded per sample and the two groups not matched on age. Age is a continuous confound that could otherwise masquerade as a treatment effect if ignored or if handled by a naive two-step covariate-removal approach, so the design puts sex and centered age into the DESeq2 model as fixed-effect covariates alongside condition, and the treatment effect is read off the condition coefficient adjusted for both. The pipeline follows the grounded procedure: sample-structure QC first (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, colored by condition/sex, with age shown continuously) to catch any sex- or age-driven structure and outliers before modeling; a minimal low-count pre-filter; DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization built into the model (never pre-normalizing counts); a Wald test on the condition term of the covariate-adjusted design with an explicit reference level and named contrast; apeglm shrinkage of the reported fold change; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering, with the p-value histogram inspected as a diagnostic. Because the knowledge service's enrichment rule set permits only an over-representation analysis (not preranked GSEA) for this situation, functional interpretation of the significant gene list runs as ORA (clusterProfiler enricher/enrichGO) against MSigDB Hallmark, Reactome, and WikiPathways human gene sets, each with the universe restricted to the tested (post-filter) genes and a 15-500 gene set size window, with GO term redundancy collapsed by rrvgo. The final report consolidates DE results, fit diagnostics, the ORA tables, and a full reproducibility record (package versions, seed, gene-set collection versions), explicitly flagging that with only 6 vs 6 unpaired samples and an unmatched age covariate the analysis has modest power and that ORA is only run if the significant list reaches a practical minimum size, otherwise the result is reported as inconclusive rather than fabricated.
